root_cause.summary: The cart service is failing to connect to its Redis (valkey-cart) storage, causing FailedPrecondition errors. These errors propagate up through checkout to the frontend, raising the observed error rate.

evidence.exception:
Status(StatusCode="FailedPrecondition", Detail="Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis
   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() in /usr/src/app/src/cartstore/ValkeyCartStore.cs:line 103
   at cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore.EmptyCart
evidence.why_it_matters: Deepest failing span is cart POST /EmptyCart with Redis connection error

evidence.message: Wasn't able to connect to redis
evidence.why_it_matters: Cart logs report 'Wasn't able to connect to redis'

proposed_action.reason: Cart service cannot connect to Redis, causing errors that bubble up to frontend

timeline.event: Earliest cited log line from cart
Alert received: Error rate elevated on frontend

prevention: Add health checks for Redis connectivity and alert before errors propagate
